definitions.explanation: The process of converting paper documents, analog systems, or manual processes to digital or electronic format.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}の{電子化|でんしか}を{進|すす}める。
{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}を{電子化|でんしか}することで{紙|かみ}の{無駄|むだ}を{減|へ}らせる。
examples.english: By digitizing invoices, we can reduce paper waste.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}では{名刺|めいし}の{電子化|でんしか}が{進|すす}んでいて、アプリで{管理|かんり}するようになった。
examples.english: The company has been digitizing business cards, and they are now managed through an app.

notes:
USAGE:
{電子化|でんしか} is a noun that also functions as a する verb ({電子化|でんしか}する). It is widely used in business and government contexts as Japan continues to transition from paper-based to digital systems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電子化|でんしか}する (to digitize)
- {電子化|でんしか}を{進|すす}める (to promote digitization)
- {電子化|でんしか}が{進|すす}む (digitization progresses)
- ペーパーレス{化|か} (going paperless — related concept)

RELATED WORDS:
- デジタル{化|か}: digitalization (broader, includes business transformation)
- {電子|でんし}: electronic, digital
- IT{化|か}: IT-ization, adoption of IT systems
